entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Amy, how can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something. It's a VeloBand Pulse, and I want my money back. This thing is junk.

I apologize for the wait time, I understand your frustration. I can certainly help you with a return for your VeloBand Pulse. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's under johndoe@email.com. And hurry it up, I don't have all day.
Thank you, Mr. Doe. I have located your order. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse. To confirm, you are looking to return it for a full refund?
Yes, that's exactly what I want. It barely holds a charge and the heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate. It's been about two weeks since I got it.

Okay, Mr. Doe. Our standard return policy is 90 days for most items. Since you are well within that window, I can definitely process a return for you. I am very sorry the smart watch is not to your satisfaction.
90 days? Seriously? The website made it sound like I was stuck with it! Okay, well great, let's get this done. What do I need to do?

I apologize for any confusion regarding our return policy. It looks like you are well within our 90 days return window, so I can go ahead and process the return. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label to your email address, johndoe@email.com, within the next 24 hours. Simply pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, your refund will be processed. You should see it reflected in your account within 7-10 business days.
A prepaid label? That's a relief. Okay, that sounds good. So just to be clear, I'll get the label in my email in the next day, ship it back, and then wait for the refund. Correct?

That is correct, Mr. Doe. The email will contain the prepaid shipping label and instructions. If you don't receive it within 24 hours, please don't hesitate to call us back. I can also escalate this to my manager if there are any concerns. This VeloBand Pulse is going to be out of your hair shortly.
Perfect. Thank you so much for your help! You've made this much easier than I expected.
You're very welcome, Mr. Doe! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Have a great day, Mr. Doe! Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support.
